author: Aesop; Joseph Jacobs, English reteller
title: The Fables of Aesop: Selected, Told Anew, and Their History Traced
edition: London and New York: Macmillan & Co., 1894; the dated title page identifies Jacobs’s English retelling, not Townsend’s translation. Transcription treatment: HTML inline emphasis is represented as plain text; page numbers, image captions, illustrations, and digitizer boilerplate are excluded. Prose line-wrap whitespace is collapsed within each paragraph; verse line breaks and stanza boundaries are retained, with indentation whitespace normalized. Original wording, spelling, and punctuation are retained, including apparent historical or transcription oddities.

rights.basis: The selected English literary text was published in 1894, before 1931, and its maximum 95-year US publication term has expired as of 2026. Project Gutenberg explicitly identifies this ebook as public domain in the USA.

acquisition.method: Downloaded Project Gutenberg HTML pg28-images.html from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror of the Gutenberg cache and converted with a scratch HTML parser: h1–h6 become headings, p elements paragraphs, stanza divs and br-broken lines stanzas (one line per printed line, indentation dropped), HTML entities decoded, inline emphasis rendered as plain text, prose whitespace folded to single spaces. Omitted throughout: the Project Gutenberg header, footer and licence, page-number anchors, illustrations and their captions, the title page and the contents. Kept: the dedication, Jacobs's preface and "A Short History of the Æsopic Fable" with its six footnotes in place after the paragraphs that cite them (as the HTML sets them), and every fable with its moral to the closing "HURRAH!". The notes and pedigree the preface mentions are not in this transcription.
